I will enhance the baseline frequency lookup by incorporating a hierarchical n-gram context model (unigram, bigram, and trigram) trained on sentence-aligned sequences. By sorting the data by sentence ID and token ID, the model can resolve ambiguities where identical raw tokens require different normalizations based on preceding words. During inference, the system will prioritize trigram context, fall back to bigram, then unigram frequencies, and finally use the raw token as a safe fallback. This contextual smoothing is expected to increase exact-match accuracy by resolving common morphological and syntactic variations in Russian text normalization.
